about_short_description.short_description: Attentive is a personalized mobile messaging platform that facilitates businesses with AI powered SMS and e-mail marketing solutions.

product.name: Attentive Omnichannel Marketing Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for planning, personalizing, sending, and measuring customer marketing across SMS, email, RCS, and push notifications.

product.name: SMS Messaging
product.description: A business messaging service for sending personalized promotional, transactional, and triggered text messages to opted-in customers.

product.name: Email Marketing
product.description: An email marketing service for building subscriber lists and sending personalized campaigns and automated messages based on customer data and behavior.

product.name: Attentive AI™
product.description: An AI-powered marketing automation suite that uses customer signals and historical performance data to create, target, personalize, and optimize campaigns.

product.name: AI Journeys
product.description: An AI-driven journey automation service that adapts message timing, content, products, offers, and calls to action to each shopper’s behavior and purchase intent.

product.name: List Growth
product.description: Subscriber acquisition tools for collecting SMS and email opt-ins through website sign-up units and AI-powered experiences.
